# Mahedi Hasan | Marketing Strategist, SEO Consultant & Web Developer

> Executive Overview: Mahedi Hasan is a senior digital growth strategist, technical SEO consultant, Founder of FrameCipher and former Co-Founder of Riha Web Tech (served 2022 until July 2025) (based in Matikata, Dhaka Cantonment / Mirpur - 14, Dhaka - 1206, Bangladesh). With over 4+ years of cross-disciplinary industry experience, he has delivered 50+ successful client deployments and generated over ৳15 Lakh+ in verifiable revenue across eCommerce, SaaS, and local business ecosystems.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **Search Engine Optimization (SEO & GEO)**: Technical site audits, algorithmic crawling optimization, Core Web Vitals optimization, semantic topical authority maps (Koray Tuğberk GÜBÜR Framework), generative engine optimization (AEO/GEO), entity-based internal link graph engineering, and white-hat guest posting with real editorial traffic.
- **Paid Advertising & Media Buying**: Full-funnel performance marketing across Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), Google Search & Performance Max, TikTok Ads, YouTube Advertising, Pinterest Ads, and LinkedIn Ads. Transparent tier-based management fees without ad-spend markups.
- **Full-Stack Web Development**: High-speed web applications built with Next.js (App Router, Server Components, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS), WordPress architectures, and custom Shopify storefronts engineered for sub-2s page loads and high conversion rates.
- **Data & Conversion Architecture**: Server-side Meta Conversions API (CAPI), Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM) server containers, first-party cookie infrastructure, and custom reporting dashboards.
